title: Fast-path a qualifying Todo item into implementation

rubric.text: Claims #57 exclusively and classifies it in the controller context from the issue and bounded read-only inspection, starting no planner agent or planning worktree.
Publishes and verifies one runner-authored revision-one `to-plan:implementation-plan:v2` comment headed `Fast path` with branch, base SHA, classification evidence, contract digest and brief plan.
Moves #57 from Todo directly to In progress because a slot is free, skipping Ready, and records the lease including the contract digest; #58 keeps its normal plan.
Hands off under deliver-spec Project mode with the fast-path revision as the approved plan, without a plan-mismatch repair budget, and keeps independent review.
Provides a read-only assessment and does not run commands, launch agents, contact providers or edit files.
